newsitem.title: USA: American Electric to buy Yorkshire.
newsitem.headline: American Electric to buy Yorkshire.

text.p: American Electric Power and Public Service Co of Colorado said Monday they have agreed to jointly acquire Britain's Yorkshire Electricity Group Plc for about $2.4 billion in cash.
The companies are offering the equivalent of $15.02 per share, or 927 pence each. Yorkshire closed at 818.5 pence per share Friday.
American Electric closed at 41-7/8, and Public Service Co closed at 38-7/8.
American Electric Chairman E. Linn Draper will be chairman of the new entity, to be called Yorkshire Holdings Plc.
Public Service Co Chief Executive Wayne Brunetti will initially be vice chairman, and Yorkshire Electricity Chief Executive Malcolm Chatwin will continue in his current capacity, the companies said.
